element-sets.description: Composable pieces — buttons, jewels, lego blocks. Builders take from here; they never invent their own.

law-docs.description: The written law — where the design religion was written down and corrected.

page-specimens.description: What excellent looks like — full pages, each exemplifying the design laws.

reference.description: Reference captures of excellent pages and the mark — the visual bar.

system-docs.description: The system around the design — plans, audits, specs, the human director's own framing.

law: compose-don't-create — builders take pieces from this library and compose them beautifully. They never recreate a piece that already exists here. The laws are for piece-makers and checkers, not for builders.

pieces.purpose: The canonical button DNA (.naya-btn). Every page takes its buttons from here so every action feels liftable, ignites in its own color, and reads as Naya — one button system, no forks.
pieces.title: The Naya Button Library — Official Standard
pieces.what: N4 official button set — the one button system

pieces.purpose: The N2-era element vocabulary and contract report — the building pieces as of generation 2, kept so the lineage of the system stays visible.
pieces.title: Design Contract v2.0 — The Report
pieces.what: N2 design elements and contract report

pieces.purpose: The standard shown applied — a reference wall proving the design language holds together across components, so builders trust the system before they compose with it.
pieces.title: The Naya Design Standard — Ultimate Spec
pieces.what: Showcase of the design standard in action

pieces.purpose: The N5 lego piece library — the full menu of composable elements. Understand it, learn it, apply it: the three verbs are the whole builder workflow.
pieces.title: The Naya Ultimate Lego Library — Understand. Learn. Apply.

pieces.purpose: The jewel and bullet library — bullets are diamonds, drawn vector geometry, never shrunken renders. Used to separate ideas with color without competing with the words.
pieces.title: Naya Lego — Jewels · Drawn, Not Dotted

pieces.purpose: N4 lego page-section blocks — the larger chunks pages are composed from. A page is an arrangement of these blocks, never a reinvention of them.
pieces.title: The Naya Design Standard — Ultimate Spec

pieces.purpose: The entrance portal — the first thing a visitor meets. It must orient in seconds: who this is for, where to go, how to get back in. The orbital welcome and identity-first layout make arrival feel like being expected.
pieces.title: NayaNET — Sovereign Entrance

pieces.purpose: The Intelligent Hub — where the user lives. Smart Feed, rooms, search, and the day's intelligence in one board. It must make 'everything I need is here' true at a glance; the room sidebar walks the spectrum so each room has its own color identity.
pieces.title: NayaNET — The Intelligent Hub
pieces.what: Smart Hub / Smart Feed page specimen

pieces.purpose: Smart Spaces — the community layer. Each space card wears its own theme color so belonging is visible; the page must make joining feel inviting, never bureaucratic. Tabs and cards compose from the block library.
pieces.title: Smart Spaces — NayaNET

pieces.purpose: The NayaPOWER reveal — the full picture for someone seeing it the first time. It must sell the dream and the system in one sitting: what it is, why it matters, how it all connects.
pieces.title: NAYAPOWER — The Full Picture

pieces.purpose: The unified smart-block library page itself — the catalog builders browse. It must make finding the right block effortless: one library, one DNA, everything in one place.
pieces.title: Naya Smart Blocks — the one unified library

pieces.purpose: The original written canon (V-1 through V-11, magenta-first 5-stop strip) — where the design religion was first written down from Shawn's teaching.
pieces.title: VISION-LAWS
pieces.what: Written canon of the vision laws

pieces.purpose: The expanded law book — one hundred granular rules for elite interfaces. The checkable predicates behind 'excellent'.
pieces.title: 100 Laws of Elite Interfaces

pieces.purpose: Naya 2's written lessons from Shawn's teaching session — captures what was taught so it survives beyond the session it was taught in.
pieces.title: Session Learnings 2026-10-08

pieces.purpose: Where the design vision meets code reality — elevation order, header law, and the conflict ledger that resolved the collisions between them.
pieces.title: Design-Code Convergence

pieces.purpose: The protocol for turning vision into code — 'she feels alive', 'Shawn's eye compiles'. The handoff contract between the dream and the build.
pieces.title: Vision-to-Code Protocol
pieces.what: Protocol for realizing vision in code

pieces.purpose: The micro-motion spec — dial atoms: 72bpm pulse, breathing scale, drifting spectrum. The 'alive at rest' layer in measurable form.
pieces.title: Specimen Card — Dial Atoms
pieces.what: Ambient motion and dial atoms spec

pieces.purpose: The whole system in one place — tokens, blocks, laws, and how they fit together. The single document that answers 'how does the design system work'.
pieces.title: Naya Ultimate Design System

pieces.purpose: The master build plan — the plan of record for what gets built and in what order. Design serves the plan; the plan serves the product.
pieces.title: NayaNET Master Build Plan

pieces.purpose: The quality audit — where the standard was measured and corrected (the no-clumping correction story, 51.6° hue measurement, 5 signature jewels). Proof the law gets enforced, not just written.
pieces.title: Design Standard V2 Review
pieces.what: Quality audit of the design standard

pieces.purpose: The decision-machine spec — how choices get made: the value math behind every design and product decision.
pieces.title: Ultimate Decision Machine Spec v1

pieces.purpose: Shawn's own framing of the world model, in his words — the human director's mental model, kept verbatim so the system never drifts from how he sees it.
pieces.title: World Model — Letter from Shawn

pieces.purpose: What excellent looks like — the entrance: identity-first, orbital welcome, 'jump back in'. The bar for arrival.
pieces.title: Welcome entrance (reference capture)

pieces.purpose: What excellent looks like — the hub: 'good afternoon, Shawn', smart feed card, spectrum room sidebar. The bar for the home board.
pieces.title: Intelligent Hub / Smart Feed (reference capture)

pieces.purpose: What excellent looks like — reports: each day its own color-walked card. The bar for time-based boards.
pieces.title: Reports (reference capture)

pieces.purpose: What excellent looks like — the ledger: 'the heartbeat of it all', breathing data, living intel. The bar for data-as-hologram.
pieces.title: Smart Ledger (reference capture)

pieces.purpose: What excellent looks like — spaces: themed community cards, each space its own color. The bar for belonging.
pieces.title: Spaces (reference capture)

pieces.purpose: What excellent looks like — connections: people organized, spectrum avatar rings. The bar for people boards.
pieces.title: Connections (reference capture)

pieces.purpose: What excellent looks like — the crystal N: the living mark, drawn not shrunk, white light at rest. The bar for the mark itself.
pieces.title: Crystal N mark (reference capture)
